imgDesc.text: A strange plant that coexists with kuuvahki energy. When <color=#ffe14b>Suffused with kuuvahki</color> , it will deploy a strong shield which is capable of blocking attacks from outside to a certain extent, as well as knock back the Abyssal Monsters that get too close. At the same time, objects that are susceptible to kuuvahki within the shield will remain <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> .

When Abyssal threats are nearby, <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> Mandragora(s) will actively move toward Spirit Bloom(s) and charge them, causing them to become <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> and deploy a shield. The Mandragora will then take cover beneath the Spirit Bloom's shield until the threat is gone.
